settings.title: Settings
settings.savedAccount: Changes apply at once and are saved to your account.
settings.savedLocal: Changes apply at once and are saved in this browser.
settings.section.zumi: Create a key for the Zumi app
settings.languageDesc: Language of the board interface. Task content stays as written.
settings.accentDesc: Used for primary buttons, the current page and switches. Status colours do not change.
settings.fontSizeDesc: Scales all text and controls together.
settings.densityDesc: Compact fits more rows on screen.
settings.notifyAsksDesc: A browser notification when a new ask starts waiting on you, while the board is open in a tab.
settings.notifyOwnerOnly: Only the owner is asked questions, so only the owner can turn this on.
settings.permissionDesc: Change it in your browser's site settings.
settings.agentsOwnerOnly: Only the owner can see who holds a token.
settings.agentsHint: Read-only. Issue and revoke tokens with the owner token through the write API or the board CLI (token.issue / token.revoke).
settings.zumi.ownerOnly: Only the owner can create a key for the Zumi app.
settings.zumi.createDesc: The Zumi desktop app signs in with this key. Create one, then paste it into the app.
settings.zumi.active: A key for the Zumi app exists (created {when})
settings.zumi.activeDesc: Revoke it if the app should stop using this board, or reissue a new one — the old key stops working at once.
settings.zumi.onceTitle: New key for the Zumi app
settings.zumi.onceNote: The key is shown once — paste it into the Zumi app now.
settings.zumi.disconnectConfirm: The Zumi app will lose its connection to the board — continue?
settings.col.name: Name
settings.apiDesc: Write API v1. Every operation is described by a published JSON Schema.
settings.licenceDesc: Open source. Gear icon from Lucide (ISC).
settings.notifyCoord: Notify the coordinator of my feedback
settings.notifyCoordDesc: Your notes and answers reach the coordinator session. board watch always works; this switch turns the webhook on or off.
settings.deliveryDesc: Watch: the coordinator follows a live stream. Webhook: the board posts to a URL you choose.
settings.watchCmdDesc: Each new note or answer prints one line and wakes the session. Recipes: AGENTS.md, "Stay notified".
settings.webhookUrlDesc: Owner feedback and answers are POSTed here as JSON, signed with HMAC-SHA256. Leave empty to stop.
settings.secretDesc: Shown as a fingerprint. Rotating stops the old secret at once.
settings.secretOnce: New signing secret. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
settings.coordViewDesc: Run board watch in your session: each owner note or answer prints one line.

quota.quiet: The publisher has sent nothing new for over 15 minutes.
quota.weekMissing: Not reported yet by Claude Code
quota.tokensNone: No token data from this machine
quota.lastUse: last Claude Code use on this machine
